## R Workshop

I worked my way through the SNASS Appendices. I particularly focused on instructions related to tidyverse, as I have less experience using this than base R. It's a really nice overview! Instructions on for example calculating means by group would have been very useful to have known when I was working on my research project last semester... I expect the sections on missings and recoding to be a useful resource to refer back to when working on syntax for data preparation.

## Final Paper

I also started to search for articles that might be relevant for my own final paper as well as to present in the second week. Since I was interested in the topics addressed by Leszczensky et al (2022), e.g. dual identities and parental support, I searched for more publications containing the key terms "dual identity" and "social network".
